metaShifts.theme: Intelligence Core Vulnerability Crisis Reaches Critical Point
metaShifts.description: Massive nerfs to core intelligence items (Bloodstone -50 HP/MP, Octarine -50 HP/MP, Eternal Shroud -4 STR) combined with hero-specific nerfs (Zeus comprehensive nerfs, Storm Spirit mana regen removal, Leshrac AoE reduction) create an unprecedented crisis for intelligence cores. This amplifies the 7.36a trend of intelligence item efficiency decline.

Following 7.36a's strength renaissance, this patch solidifies their advantage with targeted buffs (Sven Vanquisher damage, Tidehunter STR gain, Magnus buffs) while nerfing their primary counters. The systematic weakening of intelligence items creates a perfect storm for strength-based cores.

metaShifts.theme: Positioning Meta Enforcement Through Mobility Nerfs
metaShifts.description: Wind Waker cyclone speed reduction (-60), combined with comprehensive nerfs to mobile heroes (Tiny movement speed, Slardar Guardian Sprint massive nerf, Wraith King mobility nerfs) continues 7.36a's positioning-focused paradigm. The new Knockback categorization system further restricts escape mechanisms.

Holy Locket cost reduction (-100 gold) and targeted support buffs (Chen Divine Favor, Enchantress mana regen) suggest supports were struggling economically in the post-7.36 meta. This represents a correction rather than amplification of previous trends.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Sven's Vanquisher damage buff (+2%) combined with his talent buffs creates synergy with the relative strength of STR items after intelligence item nerfs. His stun-based damage amplification works perfectly with items like Armlet and Assault Cuirass.

Magnus's Solid Core now specifically reduces knockback effects (the new categorized system), while his Skewer damage buff and intelligence gain make him a perfect counter to the new positioning-focused meta where knockback resistance is premium.

PA's new Blur movement speed bonus (+3/6/9/12%) becomes exponentially more valuable when other heroes lose mobility options (Wind Waker nerf, Slardar Guardian Sprint nerf). She gains relative positioning advantage.

Tinker's comprehensive cooldown buffs (Laser, March, Rearm) make him the rare intelligence hero that doesn't rely on the nerfed intelligence items. His item-independent scaling through cooldown reduction creates a unique advantage.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Zeus receives comprehensive nerfs (Arc Lightning range, Lightning Bolt creep damage, Thundergod's Wrath cooldown, talent nerfs) precisely when his core items (Bloodstone, Octarine, Eternal Shroud) are systematically weakened. Double punishment creates unviable hero.

Storm's base mana regen removal (-0.2) and Static Remnant damage nerfs occur simultaneously with Bloodstone and Octarine nerfs. His mana-intensive playstyle becomes unsustainable when both hero and items are nerfed.

Shadow Shaman loses Hex damage amplification entirely while his talent gets reworked away from damage amp. This removes his primary scaling mechanism precisely when intelligence cores need more damage to compensate for item nerfs.

Axe's Coat of Blood armor per kill halved (0.4-1.0 to 0.2-0.5) and Berserker's Call armor nerfs occur when Blade Mail costs increase (+200 gold). His armor-stacking identity becomes economically unviable.

Carry.explanation: Blur movement speed bonus (+3/6/9/12%) provides crucial mobility in a meta where other carries lose mobility options. Benefits from intelligence core weakness without direct nerfs.
Vanquisher damage buff (+2%) and talent improvements (+5 attack speed, +1s Warcry duration) solidify his position as the premier strength carry when intelligence items are systematically weakened.
Metamorphosis duration talent buff (+10s to +30s) provides massive late-game scaling advantage. Unaffected by intelligence item nerfs due to agility-based build path.

Mid.explanation: Comprehensive cooldown buffs (Laser -3s, March scaling cooldowns, Rearm -1s all levels) make him the only intelligence mid that doesn't rely on nerfed intelligence items for scaling.
Base damage buff (+2) and Mastermind deny experience increase (+10%) provide laning advantages when intelligence item efficiency is at historic lows. Less item-dependent than other int mids.
Keen Scope attack range buffs (160/240/320/400 from 100/200/300/400) provide positioning advantages in the mobility-nerfed meta. Benefits from intelligence core weakness.

Offlane.explanation: Solid Core now counters the new knockback system, Skewer damage buffs, and intelligence gain improvement make him perfect for the positioning-focused meta while countering weakened intelligence cores.
Strength gain increase (+0.1) and Gush slow talent buff provide incremental advantages when strength cores are systematically favored over intelligence cores.
Viscous Nasal Goo duration increase (+1s) improves his teamfight control when mobility is systematically nerfed across the board.

SoftSupport.explanation: Divine Favor regen buffs (1.5/3/4.5/6 from 1/2/3/4) and Hand of God initial heal increase provide strong sustain when support economy is being stabilized.
Base mana regen increase (+0.5) addresses support economy issues while her nature-based scaling doesn't rely on the nerfed intelligence items.

HardSupport.explanation: Dispose and Rebound damage buffs provide scaling that doesn't rely on items, crucial when support economy is constrained and intelligence items are nerfed.

Carry.explanation: Strength gain nerf (-0.2) and Blade Fury mana cost increases continue the systematic nerfs from 7.36a. No longer the dominant carry as strength advantage shifts to other heroes.
Vampiric Spirit mobility nerfs (attack speed and movement speed scaling), Mortal Strike cooldown increase, and Shard damage nerf (-100%) destroy his mid-game power spike timing.
Movement speed nerf (-10), Tree Grab building damage nerf, and comprehensive talent nerfs remove his tower-pushing identity when positioning is crucial.

Mid.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs (Arc Lightning range, Lightning Bolt creep damage removal, Thundergod's Wrath cooldown, talent nerfs) combined with intelligence item crisis create unviable hero.
Base mana regen removal (-0.2) and Static Remnant damage nerfs (-20 all levels) occur precisely when his core items (Bloodstone, Octarine) are systematically weakened.
Refraction damage nerfs (-5 all levels) and Psionic Trap nerfs continue 7.36a's systematic dismantling. Intelligence item nerfs compound the problem.

Offlane.explanation: Coat of Blood armor per kill halved, Berserker's Call armor nerfs, and talent nerfs occur when Blade Mail cost increases (+200). Armor-stacking identity becomes unviable.
Rawhide health gain nerf, Horsepower movement speed conversion nerf, Double Edge Shard nerf, and talent nerfs systematically weaken his strength-stacking identity.
Guardian Sprint massive nerf (25/30/35/40% to 10/20/30/40%) and agility gain reduction destroy his mobility-based offlane playstyle in the positioning meta.

SoftSupport.explanation: Base strength nerf (-3), Hex damage amplification removal, Fowl Play movement speed removal, and talent rework eliminate his damage scaling when intelligence items are weak.
Blinding Sun duration nerf, Dying Light illusion interaction removal, missing health damage nerf, and Fire Spirits attack speed slow nerf systematically weaken teamfight impact.

HardSupport.explanation: Arctic Burn attack range nerf (-25 all levels) reduces her primary teamfight positioning tool when positioning is the dominant meta paradigm.
